Opening Melantha destroys eastern restraint #4. Spot contains subsequent lower-outer officers. Returning western Melantha destroys #2 and permits the second safe arrival.
Fang retains upper-central enemies. Midnight's arts and available crossfire remove armor before paired runners overflow two blocks; Steward damages approaches.

Friston retains lower-central enemies. Returning Melantha removes armor and runners. Final armor #34 follows row4 from column9 toward column1 and requires observed contact, sustained damage and eventual death.
Midnight retains upper-outer enemies. Actual extended Ansel heals must restore him; self-blocked enemies can interrupt central assistance.
Melantha handles opening lower-outer enemies; Spot receives later traffic. His healing stops attacks and must not permit a fourth queued enemy.

formation_structure.central_clearance: Friston never withdraws. Returning Melantha attacks his held enemies; Midnight supplies upper arts while respecting self-block priority. Steward remains for late approach damage but receives no credit for attacking enemies settled outside his verified range.
formation_structure.early_exposure_change: Steward is absent for predicted impacts 2293 and 2443. Entering at 2444 retains a potential artillery attack window through the eastern northern wait while limiting the initial shared exposure to predicted impacts 2593 and 2743. Both physicians are boosted for these two impacts.

economy.dependency: The ledger assumes surviving Fang grants and Melantha's living withdrawal. Losing those contributions is a survival or handoff failure. Death gives no refund; later DP clipping can reduce credited refunds.

formation_structure.medical_geometry: Both ordinary physicians cover Fang, Friston, each other and eastern Steward. Neither normally covers Midnight, Spot or central Melantha. Ansel's active DOWN extension reaches Midnight. Spot's active nine-cell range reaches himself and Ansel, excluding Steward, Friston and central Melantha.
formation_structure.splash_geometry: Ansel and Steward share radius-1.2 splash. An Ansel-centered impact excludes Friston and Spot at diagonal distance sqrt(2). Hibiscus is diagonally separated from Fang and Midnight. Melantha's opening locked point excludes Ansel at sqrt(2).
formation_structure.western_rotation: Steward returns after 2101 frames for upper clearance. Melantha remains centrally until 8100, then returns after 2101 frames for lower clearance. Neither withdrawal may release an unfinished blocking or damage responsibility.

tactical_thesis: Deploy Ansel first to obtain his frame-2072 boost. Keep Melantha through projectile birth 2053, withdraw at 2054, and leave the locked landing point empty. Delay Steward until 2444, after the 2443 impact, reducing his first eastern barrage exposure to two predicted shared impacts. Start Hibiscus at her first legal readiness, 2582, and reserve Spot's first healing period for the second lower barrage. Preserve central blocking, Melantha's returning damage, eastern approach fire and separate western clearance duties. This is a statically checked, unsimulated full-stage hypothesis.
